summary: China Yuchai International filed a Form 6-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary MGP renewed its application with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange to list its shares on the Main Board. This is a proposed IPO by a subsidiary, not a spin-off or other special situation as classified. The filing includes audited financial statements and risk factors incorporated by reference, but no terms such as price or valuation. There is no assurance the listing will occur. The filing is routine disclosure of an ongoing regulatory application, not a transactional event requiring special-situations classification.
